metadata.notes: Manual expert ordinal risk ranking for prioritization evaluation (Spearman Rank Correlation).

expert_ordinal_ranks.vulnerability_name: Remote Code Execution in Admin Console
expert_ordinal_ranks.rationale: Unauthenticated RCE on administrative console provides total server takeover.

expert_ordinal_ranks.vulnerability_name: SQL Injection in User Login API
expert_ordinal_ranks.rationale: Critical authentication bypass SQL Injection on production REST API.
Critical SQL Injection vulnerability on staging application endpoint.

expert_ordinal_ranks.vulnerability_name: Broken Access Control in Shopping Basket
expert_ordinal_ranks.rationale: High severity IDOR access control flaw on production basket REST API.

expert_ordinal_ranks.vulnerability_name: Sensitive Data Exposure in User Profile API
expert_ordinal_ranks.rationale: Sensitive data disclosure of user hashes on production REST API.
Reflected XSS requiring user interaction on staging environment.
